# Cultural Imprint Engine (CIE)

Canonical website: https://crown-thrive-os.vercel.app/cie
Official CrownThrive page: https://www.crownthrive.com/portfolio-details/ab13xy
API: https://uipojzbnnfifsbkivxoh.supabase.co/functions/v1/cie-api
MCP: https://uipojzbnnfifsbkivxoh.supabase.co/functions/v1/cie-mcp
Source: https://github.com/crownthrive1/CrownThrive-CIE-OS
Framework release: 4.1.0-commercial
Commercial state: LIVE_SELLABLE

CIE is CrownThrive's cultural identity and ecosystem architecture framework. It structures identity, narrative, audience, voice, representation constraints, cultural commitments and ecosystem routing across products, media, commerce, advertising, licensing, analytics and AI.

Commercial tiers: Operator $299, Studio $799, Agency $2,499, Institutional $4,999, Enterprise $7,500. API/MCP and the PentaAds bridge begin at Studio. Conditional resale, sublicensing, white-label and OEM rights require the appropriate signed CrownThrive addendum.
